supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.sourceLearningGoals: Collect categorical data to create a data set with several categories.
teachingSteps: Collect only authentic category responses using teacher-approved methods.
Choose a title, categories, consistent scale and accurate bar lengths.
Use the graph for addition or subtraction comparisons; justify answers.
supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.caution: A visually plausible dataset is not evidence of authentic class responses.
supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.targetRichV2Field: lesson-specific correction proposal; not the published canonical body

firstPartyPractice.prompt: Write a school survey question with four options and an impartial counting method.

independentEdulyticsCoolDown.prompt: Design a different class survey with six or fewer options and a way to check unique responses.

stageC.humanRubric: Student-collected responses are variable and involve privacy and teacher oversight. Never fabricate survey results.
